definitions.explanation: The sum of money to be paid back on a loan or debt, often figured per period (monthly, yearly) or as a total.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返済額|へんさいがく}。
{返済額|へんさいがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{返済額|へんさいがく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: When interest rates rise, the total repayment amount also increases.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧ (repayment) + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount, sum).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{月々|つきづき}→月々：30032_tsukizuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返済額|へんさいがく}: monthly repayment amount
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{返済額|へんさいがく}: total repayment amount
- {返済額|へんさいがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧: to reduce the repayment amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{借入額|かりいれがく}→借入額：30052_kariiregaku⟧: amount borrowed — the principal taken out, before interest
- {返済額|へんさいがく} is what is actually paid back, and can include interest.
